input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: open-tennis-robots (flagship 10): the tach jitter at which the take survey goes blind
errors: First tach_log.py draft appended to a list inside a MicroPython hard interrupt (allocates); caught and rewritten to a preallocated array before commit.
First edge-jitter estimator used a MAD scale; whole-microsecond periods made it read 0.33 us for 0.58 us true; replaced by a variance with gross outliers cut (test caught it).

doc_friction.issue: Says to wait for long commands with run_in_background; a plain `sleep N; cat` to check progress is blocked by a hook, which costs a turn the first time.

deviations.why: The pre-registered decision rule named the limit 'speaks below about 1 us'; the held-out set advised only 1 of 9 at 0.5 us, so the shipped bands put the 'speaks' edge at the clean tach (0.55 us on the estimator's scale).
deviations.did: Kept every pre-registered clause and reported it held; set the band after seeing held-out data and said so in the README, the code comment and the post.
deviations.result: Advice is more conservative than pre-registered; the tradeoff is documented.

goal: Deepen flagship 10 and bridge the simulator's jitter findings to a measurement a builder can make on a real tach.
notes: Design (lag 0.3 s, seed 7) and held-out (lag 0.45 s, seed 11) sets of 72 survey drills each; pre-registration committed at 9e4cc316f before the held-out capture. Both sets: named and advised 14/18 at 0 us, 4/18 at 0.5, 1/18 at 1, 0/54 from 1.5 us; no instant build advised. Shipped tennisbots tach-jitter + firmware/esp32/tach_log.py + tests/test_tach.py (6 tests, pass). Venture tests: python3 platform/ci/run_venture_tests.py open-tennis-robots -> ok (207.3 s, 372 tests, 58 skipped for build123d not installed), site page checks ok. check_posts ok.
